stories.want: a useful self-service Home with recognizable ordinary destinations

stories.actor: person who helps manage an organization's giving

A valid targeted or active represented task keeps its context through navigation/authentication.
Switching represented finance does not switch personal Updates, profile, organization topics or notification engagement to another human.

stories.actor: recipient of an organization-shared Updates link

Different authorized openers see their own current content.
Wrong/unverified host or unavailable access has an honest safe result without another-Tenant/public fallback.

stories.want: to sign in and continue to the exact task I opened

Auth and document capability exchanges retain their independent qualified protocols; navigation URL is not a grant.

stories.want: honest safe links and copy feedback

Clipboard success appears only after the actual copy succeeds; failures retain a useful local alternative.

Ordinary navigation/content GET/HEAD, previews, prefetch and navigation create no read, consent, message or financial effects; the independently qualified IC03 OAuth callback protocol remains permitted.

stories.actor: account holder without available financial records

Safe title/source/date/excerpt wraps; separately admitted optional thumbnail is not required.
Exact article opens only its qualified target; View all opens ordinary combined reading.

stories.actor: reader whose Updates are empty or hidden

Unavailable reading is a local failure/retry, not No updates or caught up.

stories.actor: donor returning after activity or a slow request

stories.benefit: I can continue without losing place or repeating a gift
acceptance: Accepted/processing/activation/received states remain source-defined and independent of wallet or document readiness.
Affected sections refresh without replacing Home, stealing focus, reordering the reader or restarting welcome.
Late responses after scope loss are fenced; Back restores only permitted current context.

stories.want: one combined list of my permitted posts
stories.benefit: I can begin reading without first choosing a ministry
acceptance: All means current authorized ordinary content after Hide, not all tenant-published posts.
Canonical identity/projection deduplicates placements and coauthors without merging different Updates.
Reading/publication/engagement/message occurrence remain separate source facts.

stories.want: a safe source filter that covers the actual reading set

Exact single-source filter runs before paging and changes no follow/email/Hide/giving fact.
No hidden source labels/counts or public directory are exposed.

stories.want: a clear stable transition to the chosen view
stories.benefit: I do not see another view's late results
acceptance: Changed filter starts a new scoped window and fences old pages independently of abort success.
Forbidden/stale source yields safe unavailable and deliberate All action, not automatic broadening.
Clear changes only transient filter; input/result focus and relevant local loading remain understandable.

stories.want: complete deliberate continuation and a recoverable reading position

Repeated/parallel loads produce no duplicate or omission in a stable window; changes yield typed currentness outcome.
Any client eviction retains accessible backward continuation/anchor; exhaustion never implies reading.

stories.actor: reader during new publication or access change

Restrictive changes prevent new admission and retire locally forbidden data/cursors; delayed responses cannot repopulate them.
No offline private cache or past permission is used as a new grant.

stories.want: to open a deliberate exact post while retaining my ordinary Hide choice

Opening it does not clear Hide or change post email; returning to All retains Hide.
Generic shared Updates and transient filters never bypass Hide or disclose hidden teasers.

stories.want: only authorized safe text and media with useful local failures
stories.benefit: protected material cannot leak through alternate copies

Sanitization and external-link rules apply; public cache/media fallback cannot bypass private admission.
Image/read/older-page failure stays local and never fabricates empty success or source content.

stories.actor: reader using an available reaction or comment
stories.want: the same durable allowed response across surfaces
stories.benefit: I can trust the result after returning
acceptance: Only exact current response profile/audience admits the existing engagement controls.
The one owner command derives actor, rechecks mutation authority and deduplicates intended effect.
Reload/readback proves persistence; a disabled/demo/no-op response cannot be reported successful.

stories.want: to hide or show one ministry's posts
stories.benefit: I control my ordinary reading without other changes

Hide applies before limit in full reader/Home/overview across every placement.
Show or safe Undo rechecks current rights, affects display only and restores no withdrawn content or email permission.

stories.want: to choose eligible post emails independently of reading
stories.benefit: I can receive either, both or neither

Saved email On remains distinct from verification/suppression/notification/delivery; safe blocks use existing repair only.
No toggle produces mail, bell/missionary alert, task, reading score or external newsletter request.

stories.want: each control to save only its intended value
stories.benefit: one failure cannot erase another successful choice

Owner atomically commits target/revision/evidence/fence, no inversion/full-object replacement/global Save.
Saving/result/rejected/stale/unknown is local; independent known controls remain usable.

stories.want: Off to remain effective even after an earlier uncertain On

Stale On cannot win later, including reconnect/retry; no automatic offline consent replay.
Post-email Off before dispatch admission suppresses matching unstarted optional work; in-flight truth is honest without recall.

stories.actor: person whose preference response was lost

Successful choice stays saved when feed/summary refresh fails; dependent view is separately refreshing/unavailable.

stories.want: a discoverable safe management path with both controls
stories.benefit: hiding content never traps me out of email or restoration settings

Hide/Off does not remove the edited row; post-menu removal preserves a recovery anchor/focus.
No longer authorized source leaves no name/count/tombstone oracle; restore sends no backlog.

stories.want: a useful current overview with simple direct choices
stories.benefit: I can understand my settings before entering detail
acceptance: Applicable areas follow Emails from organization, Ministry Updates, Receipt emails.
One exact topic shows direct control; one exact ministry shows its two direct controls.
No three mandatory empty cards, initial chooser, giant matrix, profile score or newsletter disabled section.

stories.actor: account holder with many topics or ministries
stories.want: complete qualitative summaries and focused management
stories.benefit: a large set remains understandable without misleading counts
acceptance: Multiple targets use source-certified complete All/None/Mixed or exact equivalent including legitimate defaults.
Reading and email summaries remain separate; no loaded-page denominator, numeric count or arbitrary ranked preview.
Unknown/incomplete summary is marked honestly; neutral Manage is not represented as completed current summary.

stories.want: a direct contextual journey and predictable Back
stories.benefit: I need no extra category or save ceremony
acceptance: Exact post/receipt links reach the allowed control through safe sign-in return.
Small detail may be inline; long sets have one focused account destination with bounded search and Back.
Back/Done navigates only; Help/Manage/Back do not toggle labels or cancel accepted changes.

stories.actor: recipient facing an unavailable or ineligible choice
stories.want: a truthful state and the appropriate existing next step
stories.benefit: I do not mistake a disabled capability for an opt-out
acceptance: Known absence/default, no optional topics, read-only, not eligible, blocked delivery and failed read remain distinct.
No topic comes from template names or a decorative switch without an enforcing sender.
Represented receipt scope affects only its qualified issuer/legal-donor area; Q13's pre-occurrence cutoff stays distinct from post-email dispatch cutoff.

stories.actor: donor with a current required step
stories.want: one clear Needs attention section
stories.benefit: I can find what actually needs my action
acceptance: Admit only qualified Q11 human request, P16 recurring episode and Q03/Q09 durable preparations/accepted changes.
Normal processing/ACH, ready documents, optional profile fields, old failure, intentional pause and staff repair are not invented chores.
A missing CTA is not resolution; exact owner-required continuing status remains truthful.

stories.want: recognizable scoped context and one useful next link
stories.benefit: I can choose an action confidently
acceptance: Each ordinary row has task title, necessary safe target context, proved consequence/date only when useful, one exact owner doorway.
Financial target and human contact/shared-login scope remain distinct; no hidden labels or invented debt/urgency.
Opening/Home/Retry-read performs no payment/proof redemption/command.

stories.want: a compact stable preview with complete further access
stories.benefit: important work is visible without an alert wall
acceptance: Three ordinary rows; exact required prominent/Urgent source treatment survives cap.
Present steps precede required waiting-only ordinary rows, then oldest certified current need with stable tie-break.
More actions adds three in page flow with qualified continuation; no invented exact total or separate inbox.

stories.actor: donor returning to a need after delay or partial outage
stories.want: current source truth without repeating completed work
stories.benefit: I can recover safely and still use other portal areas
acceptance: Distinct complete-empty/partial/not-applicable/unavailable results prevent false all-clear.
Re-read original request/result; do not reset expiry, reuse old proof or recreate completed/indeterminate effects.
Home source-only need and bell read/availability remain different; renewed direct access does not revive an old notice.

stories.want: only meaningful qualified notices
stories.benefit: the bell is useful without every payment, post or email becoming noise
acceptance: Exactly thirteen ordinary keys in the three source families require positive complete owner/catalog/recipient qualification.
Mutually exclusive receipt/refund variants never duplicate one effect; no P16/P13 duplicate alert workaround.
Ordinary gifts/ACH/saves/posts/export-ready/staff/import and unrelated recognition events create no item; protected required exceptions retain only exact qualified contracts.

stories.want: a small All-first view with clear current actions and recent information
stories.benefit: I can find a relevant notice without managing an inbox
acceptance: Desktop named Popover shows five groups; phone opens full center; full center deliberately loads twenty.
Current source-actionable before Recent, source-proved Urgent before Attention; complete overflow action count/path.
Needs attention tab available; empty wording mentions notifications, not global completion.

stories.actor: human who shares responsibility for giving
stories.want: my own scoped notification and read state
stories.benefit: another representative cannot read or clear notices for me
acceptance: Current Tenant/donor role/surface/selected giving context and exact human recipient all scope item/count/detail/engagement.
Two treasurers have independent flags; no cross-Tenant staff feed or hidden-count oracle.
Temporary access outage is unavailable, not source end; later rights do not revive old occurrence.

stories.want: reading to clear only unread treatment
stories.benefit: I do not accidentally resolve or execute the underlying task
acceptance: Opening bell, scrolling, email open, prefetch and source completion do not record human read.
Deliberate activation/Mark read uses narrow owner command; permitted navigation survives read-persistence failure.
Read never charges/retries/cancels/completes source work; source-required status remains.

stories.want: safe limited Archive and Restore
stories.benefit: I can tidy a view without hiding required work or reviving expired access
acceptance: Only admitted Information/ended history can archive/restore; current required notice cannot be dismissed.
No Mark unread/undo-read restarts ended eligibility.
Restore honors original lifetime/current access and creates no source action.

stories.want: a precise bounded scope that excludes later arrivals
stories.benefit: new meaningful information remains discoverable
acceptance: Accepted context/cutoff is durable and applied to each child's immutable availability, including late child of existing group.
Unknown/repeated result reconciles the same effect, not a newly widened batch.
Grouping retains independent child evidence and policy; no arbitrary ministry/date/email merge.

stories.actor: donor returning after time has passed
stories.want: notification history to respect its actual source lifetime
stories.benefit: old messages do not become new obligations
acceptance: Information unread ends at first qualifying ending or availability+30 days; presentation ends availability+90 days.
Actionable persists until actual once-set source end, then non-unread history90 days subject to current rights.
Reads/restores/repair/late projection/retention lag never restart clocks; stricter source expiry wins.

stories.actor: donor encountering a notice outage or stale link
stories.want: safe local recovery to current source information
stories.benefit: a broken notification does not break the task or expose old data
acceptance: List/count/detail/destination use current qualified source predicates and stable continuation.
Denied/withdrawn/replaced document or ended action yields its exact safe source state, never old download/automatic generation.
Local-only notice works without Resend; source pages remain usable during notification outage.

stories.want: an optional direct full-page overview of that exact context
stories.benefit: I can read and manage relevant records without a directory detour
acceptance: Exact P22 Page/immutable typed-subject private descriptor qualifies the link.
Multiple genuinely admitted distinguishable origins allow bounded deliberate choice only after asking; absent/unsafe association has no dead link.
Existing post/gift/receipt/Manage links remain direct.

stories.actor: donor using ministry context after a fund change
stories.want: the actual current fund scope with older records preserved
stories.benefit: I am not misled into believing older giving moved
acceptance: One current qualified D7 Designation, separately qualified D3 reading set; current means configuration not new-gift eligibility.
Old different-binding records retain original History/detail; no union/historical overview mode or name-based join.
Rebind invalidates stale composite and visibly qualifies new scope; no silent new-fund retarget.

stories.want: small independently permitted sections in useful order
stories.benefit: the page works with partial rights and on a phone
acceptance: Full-page DOM order is context, Updates, Your giving with simple section jumps.
Three admitted Update previews honor Hide and media permission; full reader carries exact source set.
Identity/reading/finance are independent; no financial donor prerequisite, stale public biography or forced new CTA.

stories.actor: donor reviewing a ministry's recurring records
stories.want: only exact matching line facts and honest further links
stories.benefit: a shared arrangement cannot misstate my support for this fund

Ended matching line remains Ended when another sibling keeps Current; required material facts survive preview caps.
No group-as-ministry total; scoped View all really scopes, and History uses exact Designation with All History reachable.

stories.actor: person leaving and returning to a ministry overview
stories.want: my authorized task and position to survive change
stories.benefit: I can resume without seeing stale or unrelated records
acceptance: Owner-only links reauthorize independently and navigation creates no business effects.
Local failure preserves independent safe sections; retired/unprovable association does not erase lawful financial History.
Back restores qualified scope/anchor or explains changed/unavailable context without substitution.

stories.actor: guest interested in a missionary newsletter
stories.want: one short request without signing up or checking my inbox
stories.benefit: I can express interest with minimal effort
acceptance: Request newsletter collects optional single Name and required editable Email with short safe recipient/purpose disclosure.
No donation/account/inbox verification/repeat email/phone/address/free story or bundled marketing choice.
Opening and typing send nothing; external missionary enrollment remains outside Core.

stories.want: editable human prefills that stay private and affect only the request
stories.benefit: convenience does not change my account or leak to another visitor
acceptance: Only current authorized human values prefill; no represented contact substitution or verified-identity inference.
Auth/profile/receipt/Updates choices remain unchanged by form edits.
Published Page/form HTML/RSC stays auth/cookie invariant; private answers/receipt/reconciliation are no-store and absent from shared cache/URLs.

stories.want: a usable single-column form with honest rejection and no-JS support

Stable submitting state preserves answers/focus; validation errors are accessible and rejection never says Received.
Existing D26 native no-JS/replay boundary works without mandatory account or a second form engine.

stories.want: a durable Request received result and simple return
stories.benefit: I know my request was recorded without a false delivery promise
acceptance: One atomic occurrence/exact plan/primary/local child/dispatch set commits before confirmation.
Normal work releases immediately; known unrecoverable capability/route is rejected with safe approved alternate.
Result distinguishes acceptance from delivery/enrollment and adds no visitor email, account/donation upsell or arrival countdown.

stories.actor: newsletter requester with a lost response or double click
stories.want: safe same-request reconciliation
stories.benefit: uncertainty does not send the missionary duplicate requests
acceptance: Same issued operation and payload returns same permitted result; changed payload/scope conflicts.
Lost browser state/timeout cannot prove no server write or auto-submit new operation.
No permanent email/missionary uniqueness prevents legitimate later requests.

stories.actor: newsletter requester who notices a submitted typo

After acceptance Use a different email deliberately creates a new request and says earlier one may have been passed on.
No accepted Edit/Undo/recall/external unsubscribe or hidden resend.

stories.want: a concise actionable governed email with truthful proof wording
stories.benefit: I can handle the request through my usual external process
acceptance: P17 publication carries escaped selected name/email/safe context and Email not confirmed through this request or exact qualified proof metadata.
Tenant-owned sender/reply/connection and each frozen member control transport; visitor controls no headers/recipient/template/tags.
Email works without a mandatory second inbox; no automatic subscriber/contact record or visitor send.

stories.want: the same bounded request under my current exact authority
stories.benefit: I can use the address without a duplicate workflow or data leak
acceptance: Generic safe purpose/time preview contains no contact details or urgency.
Detail requires frozen intended human intersect current same-Page/subject/purpose authority, including guest origin without fake supporter relation.
Copy email follows actual clipboard success; Read/Archive/Copy does not record external enrollment/handled state.

stories.want: independent durable outcomes and exact current recipient fences
stories.benefit: one failed channel can recover without repeating success or leaking to a successor
acceptance: Email Primary is complete only after each required member's conclusive acceptance; local availability is independent.
Unknown/missing acceptance identity remains indeterminate; recover residual same sealed scope, no rekey/recipient/account change.
Current recipient/suppression/connection/source changes stop unstarted disallowed work and never silently retarget old bodies.

stories.want: old request data and late work to expire at the declared limits

Prepared send authority ends at earlier source/provider stops and physical disposal follows P6's24-hour bound.
Core body/detail ends acceptance+30 days or earlier, CTA cannot outlive it, sent copy Off; read/restore/backup does not revive access.

stories.actor: legitimate guest sharing a network with other visitors
stories.want: proportionate bounded request protection
stories.benefit: abuse controls do not turn every ordinary request into a verification workflow
acceptance: Code-owned finite field/byte/member/admission/backlog/retry profile is qualified with N/N+1 and load proof.
Fast autofill, paste, international text or shared NAT alone is not conclusive abuse.
Existing accessible risk treatment may reject/backpressure honestly; no accepted-drop, victim-address lockout, routine CAPTCHA or inbox step.

stories.actor: person using keyboard, assistive technology, zoom or a phone
stories.want: the same complete readable and operable journeys
stories.benefit: I can finish tasks without hidden labels, focus traps or clipped consequences
acceptance: Visible names/current state, real headings/list/table/field semantics and actual Core touch hit areas hold at supported widths/zoom/RTL.
Focus order/return, Escape/widget keys, field errors and once-only polite feedback work in real compositions.
No essential clamp/hover-only action, nested interactive card, giant live region or automatic scroll/focus shift; axe complements manual proof.

stories.actor: account holder whose session or rights change
stories.want: private state and all alternate access paths to respect the current boundary
stories.benefit: old caches or direct URLs cannot expose another person's data

Scope-matched caches and materializations retire on loss; late results are fenced independently of abort.
No privileged fallback, raw private SSR/browser persistence, telemetry payload or Realtime permission inference.

stories.want: minimal useful source-owned diagnostics and bounded monitoring
stories.benefit: I can recover real failures without surveilling donors or inventing tasks

Exact source thresholds have an accountable owner and response; uncertainty and successful children are preserved.
Confirmed disclosure/duplicate/expired access is contained and requalified; no blanket donor cleanup or broad unsafe fallback.

stories.want: one qualified owner path and honest complete-journey evidence
stories.benefit: a polished screen cannot hide unsafe or unimplemented behavior
acceptance: Required source amendments, schema/grants/purpose versions/consuming senders and current capability gates precede activation.
Mixed-version/backfill/rollback retires contradictory readers/writers without historical send/read revival or lost valid records.

Existing Playwright primary seam plus real owner/native Auth/provider/SQL/media/document/accessibility proof covers adverse cases; mocks/skips/ratification are not release proof and G01 remains explicit.

stories.want: open my own giving immediately on a neutral visit
stories.benefit: ordinary personal tasks need no account chooser
acceptance: Personal giving opens first when available.
Only independently authorized represented contexts appear; no cross-device last-used preference is added.

stories.want: enter the giving I am permitted to manage without creating a personal gift record
stories.benefit: I can complete legitimate work with my existing access

No artificial personal donor, gift, claim or staff role is created.

stories.want: see whose giving I am viewing while my login remains mine

A narrow document/commitment grant does not open broad history, wallet or profile; names/options/counts are also authorized.

stories.want: switch giving contexts without retargeting work or preferences

Accepted tasks remain in original scope; stale responses cannot render beneath a new heading.
Only genuinely unsaved loss requires a discard warning.

stories.want: reach my admitted reading or document task without a financial donor gate

Missing/failed lookup is not widened access.

No automatic provider guessing, One Tap, mandatory popup or unrelated profile-completion step.
Unqualified methods are not presented as working.

stories.want: choose the link or code in the first sign-in email
stories.benefit: I can sign in on the device that is convenient

Paste/autofill and leading zeros work in one logical code input.
Consumed proof is not reusable on another device or a transferable session.

stories.want: have email previews and scanners leave my sign-in proof untouched

A legitimate validated OAuth callback retains its own standard exchange protocol.

stories.want: recover from expired codes, resends, denied provider consent and lost responses

No mail/OAuth on rendering; resend follows qualified source replacement/cooldown.
Return to the same safe entry and usable proved method without guessed equivalent email.

stories.want: have a new social identity prove the required native trust before joining my account

Direct native authorize/link/exchange/refresh/credential endpoints are tested, not only Core.
Already-bound subject sign-in is distinguished; no experimental broker/fork or silent provider removal.

stories.want: have provider identity and email treated according to their actual evidence

stories.want: connect or disconnect a sign-in method deliberately

Possible shared-email/session changes follow the email/security contract; unknown effects reconcile without blind replay.

stories.want: use relay privacy and recover when my Apple account changes

Web-secret rotation and lifecycle/revocation handling are proved without financial deletion or giving cancellation.

stories.want: use a publicly qualified login and receive a clear fallback when email is unavailable
stories.benefit: a development-only success does not become a broken donor experience
acceptance: Actual app mode, identity/email scope and ordinary non-role account work.

stories.want: understand the organization's brand and the external provider handoff
stories.benefit: I know which service is authenticating me

Tenant offered-entry settings do not claim a global method prohibition.

stories.benefit: I avoid repeated effort without updating unrelated contact records
